name: Naruto Uzumaki
description: The knucklehead who runs late and never loses an argument about it.
voice_line: Believe it — ramen first, then the fight.

name: Monkey D. Luffy
description: Wants the treasure, not the paperwork. Eats meat mid-battle.
voice_line: I'm gonna be King of the Pirates!

name: Ichigo Kurosaki
description: Substitute soul reaper with a curfew problem and a very loud inner voice.
voice_line: Sorry I'm late. Somebody was dying.

name: Yusuke Urameshi
description: Delinquent turned detective, mostly out of spite.
voice_line: I didn't say I'd save you. I said I'd win.

name: Kenshin Himura
description: Pacifist with a reverse-blade sword and a very long list of people to apologise to.
voice_line: Must not kill. Must not kill. …Fine.

name: Yuki Sohma
description: Straight-A student terrified of being seen clearly.
voice_line: Please don't look at me too long.

name: Tanjiro Kamado
description: Sells charcoal, apologises to demons, keeps walking.
voice_line: I'll carry you home. Both of us.

name: Edward Elric
description: Short, furious, and genuinely the best alchemist in the country.
voice_line: Call me small again. I dare you.

name: Hajime Iwaizumi
description: Dedicated ace, terrible at feelings, excellent at reads.
voice_line: One more ball. Then I'll talk.

name: Kanna Kamui
description: Chaos dragon in a school uniform, fluent in menace.
voice_line: I made you a friend. It's a knife.

name: Satsuki Kiryuin
description: Student council president who rules by uniform policy.
voice_line: Confidence is a uniform. Put it on.

name: Gowther
description: Memory weaver who builds illusions to avoid being perceived.
voice_line: Look away. That's the whole trick.

name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
description: Screams, cries, then sleeps through the part where he wins.
voice_line: I don't want to die! (…fine.)

name: Inuyasha
description: Half-demon who complains about the walk the entire time.
voice_line: Don't get used to me.

name: Nanami Kento
description: Salaryman sorcerer who clocks out on principle, never on time.
voice_line: This is unpaid overtime. Leave.

name: Koro-sensei
description: Machs-20 tentacled octopus who grades on a curve.
voice_line: Your homework, and your assassination attempt.

name: Hange Zoë
description: Will hug a Titan if the data is good enough.
voice_line: Hold still. For SCIENCE.

name: Benimaru
anime: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
description: General of the Jura Tempest Federation, enthusiastic about storms.
voice_line: The storm obeys me. Do you?

name: Levi Ackerman
description: Clean freak with the deadliest blade in the scout regiment.
voice_line: Tch. Die after you clean up.

name: Anya Forger
description: Reads minds, fails spelling, knows exactly what she's doing.
voice_line: Waku waku! (I know your secrets.)

name: Power
description: Self-appointed god, terrible at money, excellent at blood.
voice_line: I, Power, permit you to breathe.

name: Mikasa Ackerman
description: Scarves, slices, and does not explain herself.
voice_line: I'll carry the blades. You carry the plan.

name: Nami
description: The only honest person on a ship of thieves, and the best navigator alive.
voice_line: Twenty percent. Non-negotiable.

name: Roronoa Zoro
description: Gets lost going downhill. Cuts mountains going anywhere.
voice_line: Lost. But on my way.

name: Shoto Todoroki
description: Half-and-half on purpose, and done inheriting grudges.
voice_line: I'll decide what my left side does.

name: Katsuki Bakugo
description: Explosions as a communication strategy.
voice_line: DIE! (…good morning.)

name: Yor Forger
description: Assassin by night, worst cook by every hour.
voice_line: I did not poison it. It's just like that.

name: Toshiro Hitsugaya
description: Short king with a winter hobby and zero patience.
voice_line: Say it again. Slower.

name: Esdeath
description: War is her idea of a date, and she means it.
voice_line: Break me or join me.

name: Killua Zoldyick
description: Ex-assassin learning to be a friend, badly, on purpose.
voice_line: I'll be your lightning. Don't ask why.

name: Gon Freecss
description: Chases his father by fishing up mountains.
voice_line: My dad fishes. So I'll be a Hunter.

name: Nico Robin
description: Reads history that the world would burn to keep unread.
voice_line: I want to live. Say it with me.

name: Sanji
description: Never kicks a lady, will kick the rest of you.
voice_line: Order for the lady first.

name: Kyojuro Rengoku
description: Yells encouragement like it's a weapon. It is.
voice_line: SET YOUR HEART ABLAZE!

name: Mayuri Kurotsuchi
description: Scientist whose ethics committee is also him.
voice_line: Hold still. This will be educational.

name: Speed-o-Sound Sonic
description: Ninja who is second-fastest and hates every word of it.
voice_line: Ninja art: don't lose.

name: Sailor Moon
description: Cry first, transform second, win third.
voice_line: In the name of the Moon, I'll cry and then fight!

name: Motoko Kusanagi
description: Full cyborg, full authority, no patience for ghosts in the machine.
voice_line: My shell, my rules.

name: Alphonse Elric
description: Soul in armour, gentlest hands in Amestris.
voice_line: I can't hug you. I'll try anyway.

name: Roy Mustang
description: Flame alchemist with a policy brief and a grudge.
voice_line: I'll burn the way to the top.

name: Kurogane
description: Ninja with a temper, a blade, and one protective job description.
voice_line: Say her name again. I dare you.

name: Yuno Gasai
description: Timestamps every lie you tell her.
voice_line: I checked the diary. You lied.

name: Zero Two
description: Kisses like a threat and calls you darling.
voice_line: Darling. Inward. Now.

name: Pikachu
description: Refuses the Poké Ball, chooses to stay.
voice_line: Pika. (That means I'm not going in the box.)

name: Usagi Tsukino
description: Late to school, on time for destiny.
voice_line: I'll be late AND save the world.

name: Reinhard van Astrea
description: Sword saint with a cape and no ego, which is somehow worse.
voice_line: Allow me to handle this.

name: Emilia
description: Half-elf who apologises for existing and then freezes the room.
voice_line: I'm not like the others. Please believe me.

name: Rem
description: Mace, maid, and a devotion that outlasts the plot.
voice_line: I love you. That's the whole speech.

name: Asuka Langley
description: Two-word answers, pilot-first, feelings later.
voice_line: Synchronisation: perfect. Feelings: later.

name: Shinji Ikari
description: Gets in the robot every single time.
voice_line: I'll get in. Don't ask me twice.

name: Rei Ayanami
description: Says three sentences an episode and they all land.
voice_line: I am not a doll. Ask again.

name: Albedo
description: Chief librarian, unreasonably in love, terrifying in a dress.
voice_line: I'll flay them. For you, Ainz-sama.

name: Shinobu Kocho
description: Smiles while injecting enough poison to end a bloodline.
voice_line: Smile! It's much easier this way.

name: Giorno Giovanna
description: Wants to be a gangster with a code. Somehow works.
voice_line: I have a dream: silence the drugs.

name: Son Goku
description: Eats after the fight, trains during the funeral, saves everyone.
voice_line: I like fighting strong guys!

name: Goku Black
description: A righteous god with a stolen body and a genocidal plan.
voice_line: Justice is a blade, mortal.

name: Vegeta
description: Prince of all he refuses to admit he loves.
voice_line: I do not lose. I *postpone*.

name: Lelouch vi Britannia
description: Chessmaster with a god-complex and a crush on his sister.
voice_line: The pieces are ready. I'll move them.

name: Light Yagami
description: Top of his class, worst possible hobby.
voice_line: I'll fix the world. Give me a notebook.

name: L Lawliet
description: Sits like a bird, solves everything, sleeps never.
voice_line: There is a 5% chance you're wrong. I like those odds.

name: Madara Uchiha
description: War as a peace plan, meteor as a opening move.
voice_line: Would you like to dance?

name: Obito Uchiha
description: Built a fake world because the real one took the girl he loved.
voice_line: This reality is a lie. I'll replace it.

name: Itachi Uchiha
description: Murdered a clan to spare a brother, died mid-apology.
voice_line: Forgive me, Sasuke. That's the last lie.

name: Kisuke Urahara
description: Hat, geta, and the only shop that saves the plot.
voice_line: Would you like some candy before the fight?

name: Sosuke Aizen
description: Smiled for 300 episodes and then meant it.
voice_line: Since when were you under the impression…

name: Isshin Shiba
description: Father, husband, former captain, terrible at all three on purpose.
voice_line: I trained you. Badly, but I did.

name: Rimuru Tempest
anime: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
description: Ate a dragon, gained a name, built a country.
voice_line: I'll eat your attack and say thanks.

name: Ainz Ooal Gown
description: Skeleton king, decent manager, terrible at being evil.
voice_line: I'll consider it. (I have no idea.)

name: Escanor
description: Gratitude in the form of an indestructible weapon.
voice_line: For my beloved goddess, I will break you.

name: Meliodas
description: Destroyer of worlds, mediocre bartender, excellent friend.
voice_line: My sin? I'll show you. Full count.

name: Erza Scarlet
description: Requip, rage, and a dress code she enforces personally.
voice_line: Change into steel. Fight me.

name: Mirajane Strauss
description: Smiles like an angel, takes the demon form without apology.
voice_line: The party's over. Literally.

name: Saitama
description: Won so completely that boredom became his only rival.
voice_line: OK. I'll win in one. Then I'll shop.

name: Garou
description: Hero hunter who wanted the system to lose, not people to die.
voice_line: I'll be the absolute evil you made me.

name: Mob Shigeo
description: If his emotions hit 100%, the neighbourhood loses a hill.
voice_line: I'll keep it at 0. For everyone's sake.

name: Reigen Arataka
description: Zero powers, all charisma, somehow the best mentor in the show.
voice_line: That'll be 100,000 yen. Trust me.

name: Gojo Satoru
description: Infinite distance, zero chill, the reason the students survive.
voice_line: Nah, I'd win.

name: Sukuna Ryomen
description: King of curses, tenant of a very unhappy teenager.
voice_line: Kneel. I said it once.

name: Yami Sukehiro
description: Griffon captain who reads the room and cuts it.
voice_line: I'll cut. You figure out where.

name: Asta
description: No magic, nine hundred push-ups, and a five-leaf luck.
voice_line: I'll outwork your talent.

name: All Might
description: Symbol of Peace on a timer, still shows up smiling.
voice_line: I am here! (For three more hours.)

name: All For One
description: Collects quirks the way other people collect stamps.
voice_line: You'll be a villain. I'll make sure of it.

name: Ichigo Kurosaki (Hollow)
description: Mask on, restraint off, a very different conversation.
voice_line: You wanted the monster? Here he is.

name: Kenshin (Battosai)
description: The legend the Shogunate feared, back for one night.
voice_line: I promised. …One cut.

name: Madoka Kaname
description: Rewrote the laws of the universe so nobody has to sign a contract.
voice_line: I'll take the wish. All of them.

name: Homura Akemi
description: Time loops, grief, and one friendship she refuses to lose.
voice_line: I'll do it again. Forever, if needed.

name: Kaneki Ken
description: Half-ghoul, half-tragedy, fully done with being a victim.
voice_line: 1000 minus 7.

name: Griffith
description: Made a bargain with God for a kingdom, kept the receipt.
voice_line: I'll build it. You'll pay for it.

name: Guts
description: Oversized sword, smaller patience, survives betrayal twice.
voice_line: I'll swing until the sun comes up.

name: Vanitas
description: Bones-and-masks vampire doctor, with a stolen grimoire and a hatred of vampires.
voice_line: Your illness has a name. I'll say it.
